purpose: Replays the executable whole plate against the progressively deposited bead footprint.

scope.head: Samples clearance against the stock left-active H2C moving head reconstruction and bead raster. The head dimensions derive from photos. Actual installed clearance needs physical observation.
scope.motion: Follows commanded modeling moves through the final lift. Bed leveling, firmware parking, tool macros, power recovery and resumed motion fall outside the replay.
scope.nozzle: Separates body clearance from active nozzle near-field nominal overlap. Approximate rounded bead footprints include frozen geometry only. Nozzle pressure, material flow, extrusion permanence, bead curling and adhesion are physical measurements.
scope.dry: Reconstructs exact XY for each broad centerline outlier on the custom tip. The finer raster captures other nominal finite-radius local compressions. A terminal approach touching a continuous cut road is expected to give zero nominal gap.
scope.timing: Replay clocks use commanded feeds and axis limits after machine startup. They omit acceleration, startup, thermal waits and firmware park behavior. Playback elapsed includes an acceleration estimate. Neither is observed wall clock.

printed_baseline_comparison.scope: Uses the completed native tip in the same physical elevation range as the new shoulder. The selected wave shoulder phase covers the exact inclined donor shoulder region. Sample footprints use identical bead/nozzle models.
